title: HCA human reproductive atlas v1 (integrated)
source: Atlas-reporter, branch HCA_reproductive_atlas_v1: projects/HCA_reproductive_atlas_v1/h5ad_obs/obs.categoricals.parquet, cross-checked against cas.json composition categories and h5ad_obs/column_inventory.csv
curated_by: seeded from the atlas curator's own cas.json categories, then extended to every obs column by hand

notes.Collection_site: REJECT tissue. 'Wellcome Sanger Institute', 'University of Michigan' -- the institution that collected the sample. The name is the whole trap.
notes.Specimen_type: REJECT tissue. 'biopsy', 'whole_tissue' -- how the sample was taken, not what it is.
notes.Sampled_site_condition: disease, not tissue. 'normal', 'endometriosis', 'infertility' qualifies the health of the site; it does not name the site.
notes.Tissue_status: disease, not tissue. 'affected'/'unaffected' is disease state with no disease named. Kept in `disease` because it is a statement about pathology; a value mapper will get a state, not a MONDO term.
notes.Target_cell_population: REJECT cell_type. 'Not applicable', 'unknown', 'oogonial stem cells' -- the population the experiment sorted for, a fact about the protocol rather than a per-cell annotation.
notes.Tanner Stage: development_stage by the curator's own call in cas.json, and kept. A clinical pubertal scale, not an ontology stage term: 'Pubic V/Genitals-Breast V' will not resolve to HsapDv without a lookup table.
notes.Menstrual_stage: other_stage, against cas.json which left it 'unclassified'. A cyclical phase of an adult, not a point in development -- real, mappable, but not HsapDv.
notes.phase: other_stage. 'G1'/'S'/'G2M' is a computationally assigned cell-cycle phase. The only per-cell entry in any stage bucket, and the reason `other_stage` is separate.
notes.Postnatal_age_years: development_stage, and the reason the numeric gate exists. Stored as a categorical of numerals beside 'Not applicable'; profiles as bounded 1..70, 88% numeric.
notes.Gestational_age_pcw: development_stage. bounded 5..21, 97% numeric. Mostly 'Not applicable' in this adult-heavy atlas, so a row scan alone would miss the range.
notes.Batch: REJECT development_stage. Profiles as bounded 1..4, 67% numeric -- it passes the cardinality gate exactly as an age does. Name and range are what reject it.
notes.celltype_HCA_ontology_level1: cell_type. Consortium-harmonised rather than portal-standardised: the HCA master nomenclature is this atlas's own annotation, so it is a pick, unlike CxG's `cell_type`.
notes.Sex: REJECT. Constant ('female') in this atlas, and demographics in any case.
